description: DIETER (Dispatch and Investment Evaluation Tool with Endogenous Renewables) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by DIW Berlin. The Dispatch and Investment Evaluation Tool with Endogenous Renewables (DIETER) has initially been developed in the research project StoRES to study the role of power storage and other flexibility options in a greenfield setting with high shares of renewables. Meanwhile, several model extensions have been developed and applied to different research questions. Coverage: Initial version: greenfield, loosely calibrated to Germany; central European version also available. The fact sheet classes it as: Optimization. Sectors: electricity plus sector coupling (EVs, P2Heat). Resolution: time Hour, geography In most applications so far, Germany as one node; version with additional central European country nodes available. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
